prompt: We are a state government IT team responsible for hardening a new Windows Server 2022 deployment. Walk us through what the ISM Chapter 13 (System Hardening) requires and what evidence we need to collect to demonstrate compliance during an assessment.
assertions: Covers the core ISM hardening requirements: harden against vendor/ASD guidance (e.g., Microsoft security baselines), remove or disable unneeded services, accounts, and functionality, and maintain a documented standard operating environment
Includes application control and patching: application control on servers where applicable, and timely patching of the OS and applications with defined timeframes
Specifies concrete Windows Server measures (e.g., baseline/GPO configuration, disabling legacy protocols, restricting administrative tooling, local admin management) rather than generic advice
Details assessment evidence: exported configuration baselines/GPO reports, compliance-scan results against the baseline, patch status reports, application control policy exports, and change records
Structured per the skill's control-guidance format (purpose → requirement → implementation steps → audit evidence) and cites controls only in valid ISM-XXXX format without inventing numbers
